title: hasMention semantics undefined for Space-wide @everyone mentions
description: hasMention is defined as true only when the owner's ChatContact.id appears in message.mentions[]. The parent spec defines a 'mention_all' permission for Space-wide @mentions, which may not produce individual entries in the mentions array. A user could receive hasMention: false on a message that @mentions the entire Space. The spec needs to define whether hasMention covers mention_all usage, and if not, whether a separate hasMentionAll field is needed.
close_reason: hasMentionAll added as separate boolean; mentionUrgency fires when any entry in batch has hasMention or hasMentionAll true
